verdict.rationale: Data export and offboarding is a fair question for a compliance and security SaaS like Oneleet, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no export feature, no bulk-download format, and no account-exit process. The public API (157-path OpenAPI spec) and the MCP server are developer building blocks someone could use to construct an export, not a documented export capability. Deleting the AWS IAM role only revokes Oneleet's access to your cloud; it does not export your Oneleet data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
